」

pages.en:
“——What's going on? I haven't been waking well lately.”

Maybe I have too much on my mind. Or perhaps I've been having strange dreams.

“——”

I hardly ever dream, yet lately I have the sense that I keep seeing something very much like one.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
What is this? I haven’t been waking up very well recently.”
Is it because I have lots to think about or because I’m seeing strange dreams?
“
!”
Even though I usually don’t see dreams, I think I’ve been seeing something like a dream recently.

pages.ja:
「……まあ、綺麗な刀だったけどさ」
夢に見るのは、漠然とした剣のイメージだ。
その中でもあいつの短剣は頻繁に出てきてしまう。
pages.jaRuby:

pages.en:
“…They were beautiful swords, though.”

All I see in those dreams are vague images of blades.

His short swords appear more often than any of the others.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“…Well, they were beautiful swords…”
I see images of swords in my dreams.
In them, his shortswords come up pretty often.

pages.ja:

チッ。そうだよ、気に入ってるよ、悪いか」
いもしないアーチャーに悪態をついて、布団から体を起こす。
時刻は朝の六時前。
不確かな夢で一喜一憂している場合じゃない、さっさと朝飯の支度をしよう。

pages.en:
“——Tch. Fine, I like them. Is that a crime?”

I curse at the absent Archer and sit up in my futon.

It is not yet six.

This is no time to let some half-remembered dream rule my mood. I should get breakfast started.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Damn. Yeah, I like them. So what?”
I curse the person that’s not here and get up from my futon.
It’s before six in the morning.
I can’t be affected by strange dreams. I have to go make breakfast.

pages.ja:
セイバーに見送られて家を出る。
この生活にも慣れたもので、朝はとりわけ何もなく、実にスムーズに過ぎていった。

Saber sees me off as I leave the house.

I have grown used to this life, and the morning passes smoothly, without incident.

校門に遠坂の姿はない。
一成が怪しい、という唯一の突破口が消えた今、あいつも情報集めに忙しいんだろう。

Tohsaka will be looking into the people at school, so perhaps I should search the building again——

——Naturally, something that has eluded us until now does not reveal itself merely because that would be convenient.

I spend every break that morning, and the first half of lunch besides, racing through the school. I find nowhere that appears unusual.

“What? Uh… I'll just have hot water, then. I can't stand that thick texture kelp tea has.”

“Is that so? Very well. I shall procure some green tea from the faculty room by tomorrow.”

Ignoring Issei's openhearted laugh, I pour myself a cup of hot water and claim a place at the table.

“Well, time to eat.”

I clap my hands together and open my lunchbox.

At almost the same moment, a soft knock sounds at the door.

“Huh? Issei, you have a visitor.”

“Hm? At this hour?”

Issei makes his slow way to the door.

pages.en:
“——Right. I should at least bring a weapon.”

Of all the weapons in the house, the wooden sword is probably the only one that readily accepts magical energy.

My success rate with Reinforcement has risen lately, and it can turn even a wooden sword into a respectable weapon.

But that is true only of ordinary conflict.

Against a Servant or a Master, I will need something surer.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“
Oh yeah. I have to take a weapon.”
A weapon at my place
something I can easily put magical energy into
would be a wooden sword.
My success rate of the “strengthening” magic has been pretty good recently, so even a wooden sword would become a good weapon.
But that’s only in the case of normal battles.
I’ll need a better weapon if I am to fight against a Master or a Servant.

“If I could choose——I'd want swords like his.”

…Within my mind, I picture the weapons from my dream.
pages.mirrorMoon:
“To be greedy
swords like his.”
…I imagine what I saw in my dream.

pages.en:
A wedded pair of swords, one white and one black.

At that length, even I could wield them.

More than anything—with those blades, even I could hold my own in a fight.

I could defend myself without holding Saber back, and perhaps hold my head a little higher as her Master.
pages.mirrorMoon:
Twin swords of black and white.
If they’re about that long, I should be able to use them…
…And most of all
I could fight decently if I had those swords.
I’d be able to protect myself, not be a burden on Saber, and be proud that I’m Saber’s Master.

pages.en:
I sigh, my shoulders sinking, and head for the veranda.

All I can do now is what lies within my power.

In particular, I should pour my heart into dinner.

Saber may wear her usual stony expression, but I have begun to suspect that she looks forward to her meals. Lately, making her happy that way has become one of my private pleasures.
pages.mirrorMoon:
My shoulders slump as I head to the porch.
I’ll just do what I can.
For now, I’ll concentrate on making dinner.
Saber always seems so serious, but it seems Saber is looking forward to the meals. It’s been my recent secret joy to make her happy.
